user.title: Add Docker Container
user.description: Enter the details for the remote Docker container.

data_description.name: A friendly display name for this container in Home Assistant (e.g. My Web Server).
data_description.service: The exact container name on the remote host, as shown by `docker ps` (e.g. my_web_server).
data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the remote machine running Docker.
data_description.port: SSH port of the remote host (default: 22).
data_description.username: SSH username used to connect to the remote host.
data_description.password: SSH password. Leave empty if authenticating with a key file.
data_description.key_file: Absolute path to the SSH private key file on the Home Assistant machine. Leave empty if authenticating with a password.
data_description.passphrase: Passphrase for the SSH private key file. Leave empty if the key has no passphrase.
data_description.check_known_hosts: Verify the remote host against a known_hosts file before connecting.
data_description.known_hosts: Absolute path to the SSH known_hosts file on the Home Assistant machine.
data_description.docker_command: Docker executable to use on the remote host (e.g. `docker` or `sudo docker`).
data_description.check_for_updates: Periodically check whether a newer image is available for this container.
data_description.auto_update: Automatically recreate the container when a newer image is available.

error.password_or_key_file_required: [E001] Either password or key file must be provided.
error.cannot_connect: [E002] Cannot connect to the remote host.
error.docker_command_failed: [E003] The docker command failed. Check that the docker command is correct, that the executable exists on the remote host (use its absolute path, especially with `sudo`), and that the user has permission to run it.
error.host_key_not_verifiable: [E004] The host key could not be verified.
error.login_failed: [E005] SSH login failed. Check username and password/key file.
error.connection_timed_out: [E007] Connection to the host timed out.
error.docker_service_not_found: [E008] The service name was not found on the remote host. Check the name and make sure the container exists.
error.docker_command_not_found: [E009] The docker executable was not found on the remote host. Use the absolute path to the executable (e.g. /usr/bin/docker) or add it to the PATH of non-interactive SSH sessions.
error.known_hosts_not_found: [E010] The known hosts file was not found. Provide the path to an existing known hosts file, create the default one (~/.ssh/known_hosts) on the Home Assistant machine, or disable 'Check Known Hosts'.
error.known_hosts_with_check_disabled: [E011] The known hosts file was provided but 'Check Known Hosts' is disabled. Either enable 'Check Known Hosts' or remove the known hosts file path.

abort.service_not_found: The service ssh_command.execute was not found. Please install SSH Command through HACS and add it as an integration.
abort.already_configured: This docker container on this host is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: A setup flow for this docker container on this host is already in progress.
